<details>
This file is a standard systemd user service unit for the zrok2 agent. It contains no malicious code: no network requests to untrusted hosts, no obfuscation, no `eval`/`base64`/`curl`/`wget`, no credential theft, and no backdoors. The `ExecStart=/usr/bin/zrok2 agent start` line launches the application as intended by the package. The `ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/env rm --force %h/.zrok2/agent.socket` line is routine housekeeping — it removes a stale Unix socket from the application's own state directory (`~/.zrok2/`) before starting, ensuring a clean bind. This only touches the application's own directory tree and is common packaging practice for socket-based services. The `UMask=0007`, `Restart=always`, `RestartSec=3`, `After=network-online.target`, and `WantedBy=default.target` lines are all conventional, expected systemd configuration for a user service. This is a well-formed, benign service unit.
</details>
